Moonbreon: identify Umbreon VMAX 215/203 before pricing

2026-11-05

Moonbreon is a collector nickname for the English Evolving Skies Umbreon VMAX 215/203 alternate-art printing. Use the official Umbreon VMAX 215/203 record to confirm the number and artwork. A search for the nickname alone may also find accessories, other languages and unrelated Umbreon cards.

Which Umbreon VMAX do you have?

Card AI separates these English SWSH07: Evolving Skies catalog records. The following USD reference samples were retrieved November 5, 2026:

These are separate card records, not a price range for any Umbreon VMAX. These price samples do not specify a raw condition or slab grade. They are dated published references, not offers, completed-sale records or guaranteed resale values.

How to check a Moonbreon value

Confirm SWSH07, 215/203, English, and the matching artwork. Inspect the finish and record the raw condition of your copy. If the card is already in a slab, record the company and grade printed on the label. A raw card and a PSA 10 are different holdings and need different market references.

In the Card AI app, search for Umbreon VMAX rather than relying on the nickname. You can also use the Pokemon card scanner, then select the candidate you can verify. The scan does not authenticate the card or guarantee its printing.

Open the confirmed record in the card price checker to inspect available prices and history. If a condition or grade has no price, keep it missing instead of copying a value from 095/203, 214/203 or a different language.

Why can two Moonbreon price pages disagree?

The references may use different dates, conditions, grading states, markets or currencies. Some results are asking prices, others summarize transactions. Compare those fields before deciding that one displayed amount applies to your physical copy. This guide does not predict a future price or an official grade.

Save confirmed copies in your collection tracker. For a similar printing problem, compare the three English cards in the Charizard 151 guide.
